svg.aria-label: Voxel Space draws terrain from a height map and a colour map, one screen column at a time, front to back, each column drawn only where it rises above what is already drawn
svg.title: Voxel Space draws terrain from a height map and a colour map, one screen column at a time, front to back, each column drawn only where it rises above what is already drawn
svg.text: For each screen column, the renderer steps away from the camera. It draws only what rises above the parts already drawn.
Each column steps away from the camera through the maps and keeps the highest point drawn so far.
NovaLogic used it in Comanche (1992) and Delta Force (1998). Maps are images, so the terrain has no polygons.
